findings.title: Exact page-sized groups show a phantom page
findings.body: `floor(user_count / limit) + 1` overcounts whenever the member count is an exact multiple of the page size. For example, 50 members at a limit of 50 are shown as 1/2, and Next loads an empty page. Use a ceiling-based page count instead.

findings.title: Removing the last member on a page leaves the list empty
findings.body: After a member is removed, `removeMember` reloads the current page, but this offset is clamped using the model's pre-removal `user_count`. If the removed member was the only one on the last page, the requested offset is now at or past the new total, so the refresh returns no members and leaves the UI on an empty page. Adjust the offset after receiving the updated total, or move back a page when necessary.
